title: Conditional κ = 0.001678123830633547: rectangular (k=5) boundary batching and radix-distributed sparse-union schedule on PR1673's capped phase-cell fusion outer, pivot-566+554 T74 supplier
body:
## Summary

Conditional κ = **0.0016781238306335473083421558390362687182218966358657650331660405387910568682486186577879457360762643**. Capped phase-cell fusion outer (PR1673, Vlado Vojdanovski) on this repository's T74 supplier (pivot-566 and pivot-554 helper-donor kernels, certified complex endpoint 0.00167975495612554452133567...), free strict slacks at 1e-64 or below, b = certified endpoint - 1e-64, with two NEW constructions (not in PR1673 or PR1699): a radix-distributed sparse-union schedule (outer/UNION-SCHEDULE.md) and rectangular boundary batching with W^5 right-hand-side columns per factor page (outer/RECT-BOUNDARY.md), using the published omega(1,1,5) < 6.156708 of Francois Le Gall (SODA 2024, arXiv 2307.06535, Table 3) at tau_eff = omega(1,1,5) - 4 = 2.1567081 (fixed format exponent sigma = 6.1567081 strictly above the bound). The 54 strict inequalities, 9 rejecting controls (including reinstating the old union row and sigma at or below the published bound, which fail) and the endpoint rejection are regenerated with an independent balance derivation; two executable schedule simulations are run; the supplier's full native admission is rerun. Conditional, with all inherited all-size hypotheses; the new constructions need independent review; the exponent is a cited theorem.

Outer (PR1673 capped phase-cell fusion): regenerated exact ledger (53 strict inequalities, 9 rejecting controls incl. the old g-factor union row and sigma at or below the published rectangular bound, larger endpoint rejected by the native moment), independent balance derivation, the exact union-schedule simulation and 19 exact evidence replays all pass. Conditional kappa 0.0016781238306335473083421558390362687182218966358657650331660405387910568682486186577879457360762643 (union schedule outer/UNION-SCHEDULE.md; rectangular boundary batching k=5 outer/RECT-BOUNDARY.md, omega(1,1,5)<6.156708, tau_eff=2.1567081).
